name: mlx-lm
notes: Apple's mlx-lm (MIT) as its OpenAI-compatible server (mlx_lm.server): every architecture mlx-lm knows (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, DeepSeek, …), a model folder of MLX weights. mlx_lm.server takes no API key: while it runs, other programs of this machine can ask it too (it listens on 127.0.0.1 only)
